chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from a number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, who said:

I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saying: The woman in nifas sits out for the days of her menstruation that she used to menstruate, then she exercises precaution, performs ghusl, and offers salat (prayer).

key_terms.أَيَّامَ حَيْضِهَا: the days of her usual menstruation
key_terms.تَسْتَظْهِرُ: she takes an additional precautionary measure

ai.seo_question: How many days does a woman in nifas refrain from salat (prayer) according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the woman in nifas after childbirth. It states that she refrains for the number of days corresponding to her usual menstruation, then takes precaution, performs ghusl, and resumes salat (prayer).
